name: Your Company
tagline: A wedding they’ll remember at every family table
niche: Wedding and banquet hall in Tashkent

listing.description: A website for a wedding hall, banquet restaurant or event agency. A magazine cover with rings that draw themselves and falling petals, the day’s schedule along a central thread, packages styled like a banquet menu.

seo.title: Your Company — wedding and banquet hall in Tashkent
seo.description: Three halls for 80 to 600 guests, our own kitchen, décor and a wedding coordinator. Banquets from 290,000 UZS per guest, free menu tasting.
seo.answer: Your Company is a wedding and banquet venue in Tashkent with three halls: Guliston for 80–150 guests, Nur for up to 300 and the Grand Hall for up to 600. Banquets start at 290,000 UZS per guest including food, table setting and waiters; décor and a coordinator are included from the Classic package. A date is held with a 20% deposit.

sections.title: Your Company
sections.subtitle: Three halls, our own kitchen and a team that runs your day from the first dance to the last guest. You just celebrate.

sections.label: About us
sections.title: We hold everything so you can hold each other’s hands
sections.text: A wedding in Uzbekistan means hundreds of guests, a dastarkhan and dozens of decisions in one evening. Since 2018 we have hosted more than a thousand celebrations and we know where timing usually breaks. So every couple gets one coordinator: they meet you in advance, bring the host, musicians, photographer and kitchen into one plan and stand by the stage all evening. The kitchen is our own, nothing is brought in: plov, samsa and cakes are made here, so hot dishes arrive hot.

sections.label: Halls
sections.title: Three halls for celebrations of every size

items.title: Guliston
items.text: An intimate hall with a garden and summer terrace. For nikoh, fatiha and European-style weddings.

items.title: Nur
items.text: A bright hall with crystal chandeliers and a separate bridal room.

items.title: Grand Hall
items.text: A 12-metre stage, lighting and sound for live music, two entrances for guests and the cortege.

items.title: 16:00 — The bridal room
items.text: Quiet, a mirror, coffee and a photographer before you meet the guests.

items.title: 17:30 — Welcoming guests
items.text: Hostesses seat guests according to the plan; a welcome buffet and music at the entrance.

items.title: 18:30 — The couple’s entrance
items.text: The lights dim, your song plays and the doors open exactly on cue.

items.title: 20:00 — Main course and plov
items.text: Plov comes out of our kitchen on platters while the guests dance lazgi.

items.title: 22:00 — Cake and first dance
items.text: A cake from our pastry kitchen and the dance you’ve rehearsed for a month.

items.quote: We didn’t look at the clock once. Our coordinator Nigora solved everything before we even noticed.
items.author: Sevara & Jasur

items.quote: The plov was hot for all 500 guests — grandma still talks about it.
items.author: The Karimov family

items.q: How do I book a date?
items.a: Come and see the halls, choose a date and pay a 20% deposit under contract. The balance is due 10 days before the event.

items.q: Can we taste the menu in advance?
items.a: Yes, a tasting for two is free once the date is booked. Parents can join for 150,000 UZS per person.

items.q: Can we bring our own drinks and cake?
items.a: Drinks — yes, with no corkage fee. You can order a cake from us or bring your own with the bakery’s certificate.

items.q: What if the guest count grows?
items.a: We fix the final guest count 5 days before. Until then you can add guests at the package price.
Yes, a guarded car park for 120 cars and a separate bay for the cortege by the main entrance.

sections.label: Visit
sections.title: Come and see the halls
sections.text: Send your preferred date and rough guest count — we’ll reply with available dates and book you a tour.
